items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Sortable, filterable, paginated client-side table with a composable filter toolbar.

items.name: server-pagination-table
items.title: SSR Pagination Table
items.description: Only the current page's rows are sent to the browser; the URL is the source of truth and a route loader resolves the page server-side.

items.name: server-filter-table
items.title: SSR Filter Table
items.description: Column filtering resolved on the server the same way SSR pagination resolves pages, with manualFiltering and a URL-driven filter state.

items.name: server-combined-table
items.title: SSR Sort + Filter + Pagination
items.description: Sorting, filtering, and pagination all resolved together on the server from one URL and one request, in that order — the way real dashboards actually work.

items.name: deployments-table
items.title: Deployments Table
items.description: Hosting-platform style deployment history with status and build time, branch and commit, search, and environment, status, branch, and date filters with faceted counts.

items.name: logs-table
items.title: Logs Table
items.description: Observability-style log explorer with a date range picker, multi-select level, service, and status filters with live counts, highlighted search, and rows that expand into the full event.

items.name: logs-table-side-panel
items.title: Logs Table — Side Panel
items.description: The logs explorer with a details panel on the right: click or arrow through events while the table hides columns to make room.

items.name: tree-table
items.title: Tree Table
items.description: Hierarchical rows with expand/collapse, sorting, and search that keeps a matching row's ancestors visible.

items.name: tree-table-selection
items.title: Tree Table — Selection
items.description: Tree table with cascading checkbox selection and indeterminate state for partially-selected branches.

items.name: tree-table-reorder
items.title: Tree Table — Reorder
items.description: Drag-handle row reordering scoped to siblings within the same parent, built on @dnd-kit/sortable.

items.name: reorderable-table
items.title: Reorderable Table
items.description: Drag rows to reorder them, built on @dnd-kit/sortable.

items.name: resizable-reorderable-columns-table
items.title: Resizable / Reorderable Columns
items.description: Drag a header's grip to reorder columns, drag its edge to resize, with the resulting layout persisted to localStorage.

items.name: column-pinning-table
items.title: Column Pinning Table
items.description: Excel/AG Grid-style column pinning — freeze columns to the left or right edge from a hover control in the header while the rest of the table scrolls underneath.

items.name: grouped-table
items.title: Grouped Table
items.description: Rows grouped by a column value with collapsible group headers and live subtotals via aggregationFn.

items.name: pivot-table
items.title: Pivot Table
items.description: Dashboard-style analytics: pick which dimension becomes rows, which becomes columns, and how to aggregate (sum, average, count).

items.name: master-detail-table
items.title: Master-Detail Table
items.description: Expand a row to reveal a nested sub-table detail panel, rendered as a full-width row beneath the row that owns it.

items.name: editable-table
items.title: Editable Table
items.description: Inline cell editing with per-cell validation, optimistic updates against a simulated save, and single-step undo.

items.name: animated-icons-table
items.title: Animated Icons Table
items.description: Row actions built with Iconimate animated icons (favorite, notify, archive, delete) that animate on hover, focus, and click instead of static glyphs.

items.name: async-actions-table
items.title: Async Row Actions
items.description: Row actions with animated icons that reflect request state: sync spins while pending and becomes Retry on failure, archive offers Undo, and delete needs a confirming second click.

items.name: live-status-table
items.title: Live Status Indicators
items.description: A service-health table whose status and latency columns update on their own on a timer, with a pulsing indicator for actively-monitored states and a Live/Paused toggle.

items.name: kpi-table
items.title: Summary / KPI Table
items.description: Compact metrics table with period-over-period change and a hand-rolled SVG sparkline per row.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison Table
items.description: Pricing plans as columns in an ordinary bordered table, with dynamically generated columns and the recommended plan tinted.

items.name: heatmap-table
items.title: Heatmap Table
items.description: Matrix data with cell background intensity mapped to value, normalized globally across the whole table.

items.name: conditional-formatting-table
items.title: Conditional Formatting Table
items.description: Excel-style conditional formatting — a small rule engine highlights cells, colors text, and re-colors badges based on the whole row, not just one value.

items.name: production-dashboard-table
items.title: Production Dashboard Table
items.description: A production-line status table combining conditional formatting, output/utilization progress bars, and 7-day trend sparklines on one realistic dataset.

items.name: inventory-allocation-table
items.title: Inventory Allocation Table
items.description: Editable inventory grid with expandable batch allocation and live formula columns — reorder point, days of cover, and suggested PO recalculate on every edit, with FEFO auto-allocation.

items.name: density-export-table
items.title: Density & Export
items.description: Compact/comfortable/spacious density toggle, CSV/Excel export, and a print-optimized PDF view via window.print().

items.name: export-config-table
items.title: Export Configuration
items.description: Export button opens a dialog to filter by status, region, and date, pick columns and CSV or Excel, with a live count of matching rows before download.

items.name: export-selected-table
items.title: Export Selected Rows
items.description: Row checkboxes with selection that persists across pages, a page-level select-all plus a Select all shortcut, and CSV or Excel export of only the selected rows.

items.name: mobile-cards-table
items.title: Mobile Cards Table
items.description: Transforms into stacked, labeled cards below a container-query breakpoint using pure CSS display overrides on the same markup — no separate mobile component, no JS media query, no viewport dependency.
